name: Upload
summary: Select files by clicking a drop zone or dragging onto it.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-uploader> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; hover and drag-over toggle a class on the persistent zone so the border and tint animate. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: multiple

capturing typed text, not a file
choosing a value from presets rather than importing

opinion.note: State what you accept in the zone copy and set `accept` to match. Validate size and type on change and show errors near the zone. Offer both click and drag — both are wired here.
opinion.dsv3: Dashed border-strong zone on white, lifting to color-primary border + bg-accent tint on hover/drag. Border and tint animate via the shared motion tokens on the persistent zone — no subtree rebuild.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
